unep-wcmc.wdpa.name: World Database on Protected and Conserved Areas
unep-wcmc.wdpa.summary: The global inventory of protected areas and other effective conservation measures — national parks, nature reserves, marine protected areas, World Heritage sites and more — reported by governments and compiled by UNEP-WCMC and IUCN. Updated monthly.
unep-wcmc.wdpa.attribution: UNEP-WCMC and IUCN, Protected Planet: The World Database on Protected and Conserved Areas, Cambridge, UK. Available at www.protectedplanet.net

useStatus.restricted: Protected Planet's terms bar commercial use, including revenue generation, without UNEP-WCMC's written permission; licence through IBAT before shipping.

usgs.padus.name: Protected Areas Database of the United States (PAD-US) 4.1
usgs.padus.summary: The national inventory of public and protected land: federal, state, local and tribal holdings and land owned by nonprofit conservation organisations, coloured by managing agency.
usgs.padus.attribution: PAD-US 4.1, U.S. Geological Survey Gap Analysis Project

layers.name: Public & Protected Lands
layers.summary: Land owned by federal, state, local and tribal governments and by nonprofit conservation organisations, coloured by manager.

layers.name: Protected Areas (World)
layers.summary: National parks, nature reserves and marine protected areas in every country. In the United States, Public & Protected Lands is more detailed.
